review.finding: org-schema-sync.test.ts's per-field regex requires a segment to start with the identifier; a preceding JSDoc comment on unpricedCallsTotal/anyNotMeasured made both fields silently invisible to the drift guard on BOTH sides identically. Fixed: added a stripComments() pass before splitTopLevel() in both interfaceFields() and armInfo(). Falsified by temporarily dropping anyNotMeasured from the client mirror, confirming the guard failed red, then restoring it and confirming green.
review.suggestion: Strip block/line comments before matching field declarations.

review.finding: usageNoteText(lead.usage) was computed twice in the same render. Fixed: extracted to a single const usageNote at the top of LeadCard, reused in the JSX.

LeadCard.test.tsx's file-header comment still said 'usage-fills-budget-and-runs', stale after the wording purge this iterate performs. Fixed: reworded and added a pointer to the sibling FR-04.30 test file.

makeWrapper()/UNMEASURED_LEAD duplicated between the two split LeadCard test files. Accepted as-is per the reviewer's own assessment — a one-off from the 300-line-convention split, flagged only for a future third sibling file.

The composite roster route (GET /api/org/leads) forwards the two new usage fields via a trivial spread, but had zero direct test coverage proving the end-to-end pass-through. Fixed: added a test asserting GET /api/org/leads surfaces unpricedCallsTotal + anyNotMeasured.

isValidUsagePayload accepted a non-integer unpricedCallsTotal (e.g. 2.5), which would render as '2.5 unpriced calls'. Already caught independently by the external review cascade and fixed before this report landed: Number.isFinite -> Number.isInteger, with a new 502 test case.
